verdict.rationale: Conductor's cloud offering runs agents in sandboxes that spin up in seconds (conductor-docs-20), where the agent can run builds and edit setup scripts without per-step confirmation (conductor-docs-17, conductor-docs-32). Local mode only isolates work in a separate git worktree on the user's machine, not a container (conductor-docs-29, conductor-comm-17), so sandboxing covers the cloud path only. missing for 10: documented network egress controls, tool/permission restrictions inside the sandbox, sandboxing for local workspaces, and independent hands-on corroboration of the cloud sandbox's isolation guarantees.
